name: Sunflower seed wax
description: Sunflower seed wax (CAS 68937-99-5 ) is a natural plant-derived wax obtained from sunflower oil refining, valued across personal care and industrial markets for its structuring and rheology-modifying performance. It provides firm, stable texture in formulations where synthetic waxes or animal-derived alternatives are being replaced. In cosmetics, it functions as a primary structurant in lip balms, solid sticks, and anhydrous creams. The wax delivers a clean, non-greasy skin feel that formulators target in natural and clean-label product lines. Coating formulators use it to improve surface hardness and slip resistance in protective coatings. These coatings are used for paper, packaging, and wood substrates. In lubricant applications, it contributes dry lubrication and release properties in solid lubricant blends and mold-release formulations. Adhesive and sealant manufacturers incorporate it to adjust viscosity and open time in hot-melt systems. Sunflower seed wax is supplied as a solid, typically in flake or pastille form, suited for bulk handling. Food-grade and cosmetic-grade specifications are the most commonly available, with natural and organic-certified grades offered to meet clean-label sourcing requirements for global manufacturers. Standard packaging includes bags and fiber drums, with bulk quantities available for industrial procurement. This material ensures high performance across diverse chemical and manufacturing sectors.
